entries.title: Colossians 4:1
segments: Masters, give to [your] slaves what [is] just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in Heaven.

entries.title: Colossians 4:2
segments: Continue in prayer and watch in it with thanksgiving,

entries.title: Colossians 4:3
segments: praying together about us also, that God may open to us a door of the Word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I also have been bound,

entries.title: Colossians 4:4
segments: that I may make it clear, as I ought to speak.

entries.title: Colossians 4:5
segments: Walk in wisdom toward those on the outside, redeeming the time.

entries.title: Colossians 4:6
segments: Let your speech [be] always with grace, having been seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

entries.title: Colossians 4:7
segments: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in [the] Lord, will make known to you all things about me.

entries.title: Colossians 4:8
segments: I sent [him] to you for this very purpose, that he might know the things about you, and that he might comfort your hearts,

entries.title: Colossians 4:9
segments: along with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is [one] of you. They shall make known to you all things here.

entries.title: Colossians 4:10
segments: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (regarding whom you received commandments; if he comes to you, receive him),

entries.title: Colossians 4:11
segments: and [greetings from] Jesus, who is called Justus, those being of the circumcision. These alone [are my] fellow-workers for the kingdom of God, who became a comfort to me.

entries.title: Colossians 4:12
segments: Epaphras greets you, he being of you, a servant of Christ, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

entries.title: Colossians 4:13
segments: For I bear him record that he has a great zeal for you and for those [who are] in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis.

entries.title: Colossians 4:14
segments: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

entries.title: Colossians 4:15
segments: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church in his house.

entries.title: Colossians 4:16
segments: And when this letter is read before you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the [letter] of Laodicea.

entries.title: Colossians 4:17
segments: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in [the] Lord, that you fulfill it.

entries.title: Colossians 4:18
segments: The salutation of Paul, by my own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace [be] with you. Amen.
